changes: ✨ **Idle timeout** — automatically signs out the user after the server-configured idle period (from QW_Login Idle_time) with an inactivity toast.
🔄 **Cost formatting** — cost and price columns now display as 9,999,999.00 (comma-separated thousands) both on screen and in all export formats.
🐛 **Additional fields order** — toggling "Show additional fields" no longer reorders core columns; extra fields always appear after Revision.
✨ **Rich cell tooltips** — hovering a truncated text cell shows a framed tooltip with the full content; hovering an image cell shows the full-size image pinned until you move away.
✨ **Image field support** — HTML fields containing `` tags now render inline thumbnails (20px) with a full-size hover preview.
🔄 **Fixed row height** — all rows are a uniform height regardless of HTML content in fields.
🐛 **View persistence** — active sidebar view (BOMs / Part Catalog) is now remembered across browser reloads.
🐛 **Image URL fix** — triple-slash paths in Orcanos image URLs (e.g. `///covarisFTP/...`) are normalised to a single slash before rendering.
🐛 **Tooltip only on truncated content** — tooltip no longer appears for fields whose text fits fully in the cell.
🔄 **Login icon** — icon moved inline with BOM Viewer title, smaller size matching the sidebar style.
🔄 **Branding** — app renamed to BOM Viewer; Orcanos icon replaces the letter mark in both the sidebar and login screen.
🔄 **Sidebar** — narrowed to 200px; icon rendered larger inside a white circle to match login screen style.
✨ **Version on login** — app version shown at the bottom of the login card.
✨ **Project auth check** — login now verifies the user is authorised for the configured Orcanos project; shows 'Not authorised for this project' if not.
🐛 **Default columns** — Quantity and Part Status (PI) now visible by default; Status correctly shows for both PRTs and PIs.
✨ **Summary export: cost totals** — Unit Cost and Total Cost columns added per row; Total Cost shown prominently at the top of the BOM. Appears only when cost data is present in the filter.

✨ **Additional fields toggle** — toolbar checkbox hides non-essential columns by default (Key, Name, Status, Routing State, Revision shown); check to reveal all fields. Selection persisted per user in the browser.
✨ **Search history** — clicking the search box shows a dropdown of previous searches, persisted per user in the browser.
✨ **Export progress** — Export modal now shows live "Fetching… X / Y" progress while walking the BOM tree, matching the expand-all counter style.
✨ **Summary export: Occurrences** — Summary view now includes an Occurrences column showing how many times each part appears in the BOM (across JSON, CSV, HTML, and PDF).
✨ **Related ECOs** — ⋯ menu on any row now includes "Related ECOs"; opens a popup table of ECOs that reference the part (filter 612, Item_Type CR).
🐛 **Where Used PI arg** — PI rows now send the numeric cs21Int to fn_GetRootParentByCS21 instead of the full Display_text label.
✨ **Release notes: bold labels** — change titles now render in bold; **text** is parsed client-side so asterisks no longer show as literal characters.
✨ **Release notes: icon legend** — footer shows ✨ New · 🐛 Fix · 🔄 Update · ⚡ Performance · 🗑️ Removed so the icons are self-explanatory.

✨ **Summary export** — new View option in the Export modal. Fetches the full BOM, groups all children by part key, sums quantities across every occurrence, and outputs one line per unique part. Works for JSON, CSV, HTML, and PDF; files get a -summary suffix.

🗑️ **Background probe removed** — reverted the initial-load background probe (added in 0.5.4). Icons and chevrons are now determined on expand (probe-on-expand), same as before 0.5.4. The background probe caused display issues on the main screen.

🐛 **Export node order** — BFS fetch returned all siblings before any grandchildren, so 4.13.1/4.13.2 appeared after all 4.x rows. Nodes are now reordered to DFS so each parent is immediately followed by its descendants in all export formats.

🐛 **Export full tree** — export was only outputting loaded/visible nodes. Each format now independently BFS-fetches the entire BOM subtree from Orcanos (concurrency 6, page size 500) regardless of what is expanded on screen.

🔄 **Where Used state preserved** — main BomTree stays mounted (hidden) while Where Used is active; pagination, search, expanded subtrees and child cache survive a round-trip and are restored instantly on Back.

🔄 **Locate: level-order BFS** — Locate now fully expands each level before scanning, stops on first match, and works even when the tree is already expanded (reads live nodes from nodesRef instead of dispatching a no-op).
🐛 **Locate highlight persistent** — amber highlight now stays until the next Locate or Back; fixed CSS specificity with !important so nth-child(even) and :hover don't override it.
✨ **Level numbers** — each BOM's direct children show 1, 2, 3; grandchildren show 1.1, 1.2, etc. Root rows show no number. Appears in the tree cell and in all export formats.
✨ **Background probe** — top-level BOMs are probed on load (concurrency 6) so chevrons and icons appear without requiring a click. (Reverted in 1.0.2.)
✨ **Export modal** — ⋯ menu on BOM rows opens an Export modal; pick JSON, CSV, HTML (interactive), or PDF.

🐛 **Locate on expanded tree** — Locate now highlights correctly when the BOM tree is already expanded. Previously CHILD_LOAD_OK was a no-op for already-expanded nodes; now Locate reads children directly from the live node list.
🐛 **Export level numbers** — root BOM row now shows no number; direct children are 1, 2, 3; grandchildren are 1.1, 1.2, etc. Applied to JSON, CSV, and HTML/PDF exports.
⚡ **Background probe on load** — top-level BOMs render immediately, then each root is probed (concurrency 6) to determine if it has children. Chevrons and icons update in-place as probes complete.
🔄 **Level number restart** — each BOM's direct children now restart at 1, 2, 3 instead of chaining off the root's number. Grandchildren are 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, etc. relative to their own parent.
🔄 **Level numbers: hide root** — level numbers no longer shown on root (BOM) rows; only children display their hierarchical position.
🗑️ **URL column removed from export** — the Key column is already a hyperlink in HTML/PDF exports; a separate URL column is redundant. JSON and CSV no longer include a URL field.
✨ **Level numbers in tree** — every tree row shows its hierarchical position (1, 1.1, 1.1.1, …) as a dimmed prefix before the chevron.
✨ **⋯ action menu** — small dropdown on BOM rows in the Tree cell; currently contains Export only.
✨ **Export: JSON** — recursive tree structure with number, type, fields{}, and children[].
✨ **Export: CSV** — flat table with # (level number), Type, and all visible columns.
✨ **Export: HTML** — self-contained file with inline CSS + vanilla JS expand/collapse; level 1 expanded by default; Key column links to Orcanos.
✨ **Export: PDF** — same HTML in print mode opened in a new tab; browser print dialog handles PDF conversion.

🐛 **Locate highlight visible** — `.bom-row--located` was being overridden by `tr:nth-child(even)` and `tr:hover` (higher specificity), so the amber background vanished after the 1s animation. Fixed with `!important`.
🔄 **Where Used: state preserved on Back** — main tree stays mounted (hidden) while Where Used is active; all state restored instantly on Back.
🔄 **Locate: true level-order BFS** — fully expands the current level before scanning; stops on first match.
🔄 **Locate: persistent highlight** — amber flash settles to a steady highlight that stays until the next Locate or Back.
🗑️ **Removed cs21Equals param** — unused `cs21Equals` parameter removed from `fetchChildren`.
🔄 **Locate: incremental BFS** — expands the BOM level by level and stops the moment the target is found, instead of walking the entire subtree.
✨ **cs21Equals filter** — added optional `cs21Equals` parameter to `fetchChildren` and `findAndExpand` for per-level server-side filtering.
🐛 **Where Used SQL arg for PI** — Part Instances now pass their raw CS21 value to `fn_GetRootParentByCS21` instead of the extracted integer. Added `row.cs21Raw` to the row normalizer.
🔄 **Locate: id-based matching** — descendant matches when its CS21 integer equals the target (PRT → part's own id; PI → CS21 integer from Master Part Source).
✨ **cs21Int field** — each row now exposes `cs21Int`, the first run of digits from CS21 / Master Part Source.
🔄 **Locate: CS21 matching** — Locate now matches the descendant whose CS21 (Master Part Source) value equals the where-used item's CS21, replacing the previous Key-similarity heuristic.
🔄 **Locate: Key matching** — Locate now matches descendants by Key (User_Prefix) similarity instead of originalId.
✨ **Where Used** — magnifier icon on every non-BOM row swaps the tree to BOMs containing that part (`fn_GetRootParentByCS21`).
✨ **Locate** — each Where-Used BOM has a crosshair button that expands the BOM and scroll/flash-highlights the matching descendant.
✨ **Where Used: Back banner** — returns to the previous view; switching sidebar also exits Where Used.
✨ **Where Used: empty state** — shows 'This item is not used in any BOM' when no results.
🔄 **Key column is Orcanos link** — the Key value is now a purple hyperlink opening the matching PRT/PI in Orcanos. Removed the separate Orcanos Link column.
✨ **Server-side search** — search box hits Orcanos with `[Obj_name] LIKE '%query%'` so matches across all pages are returned.
🔄 **Configurable page size** — `<pageSize>` in settings.xml (default 50, clamped 1–500), shown in the Settings modal.
🔄 **Configurable BOM prefixes** — `<bomNamePrefixes>` in settings.xml controls which Part Catalog rows get the BOM icon.
🔄 **Probe-on-expand restored** — probing runs only when the user clicks `>`; initial page load is a single fetch with no upfront probing.
🔄 **Sidebar: Settings moved to popup** — Settings and Release Notes moved into a popup menu on the username at the bottom; main nav now contains only BOMs and Part Catalog.
✨ **Pagination** — First/Prev/Next/Last buttons on the BOMs main page; status bar shows BOMs N–M of K · page X/Y.
✨ **Part Catalog view** — new sidebar entry calling filter 611; reuses BomTree, hook, and probe cache.
⚡ **Probe cache** — children's children cached by `parent_original_id` on expand so the next click is instant.
🐛 **Refresh/Retry crash** — buttons no longer pass the React click event into the request body (circular-JSON crash). Added numeric guard in `loadTop`.
🐛 **Quantity column restored** — Quantity was accidentally hidden in 0.2.0; restored as a synthetic column.
🔄 **API: IsReturnPageCount=0** — filters 609/610 returned empty Data with 1 otherwise.
🔄 **API: parent_original_id filter** — children filter now uses `parent_original_id = <id>` instead of `[Master Part Source] = '<name>'`.
🔄 **API: original_id extraction** — extracts `original_id` from a PI's Master Part Source value (e.g. `PRT-39382-…` → `39382`).
🔄 **API: Display_text preferred** — row lookup falls back from byName to byTitle and prefers Display_text so picklists render their label.
⚡ **Probe on expand** — probes each child for grandchildren on expand; leaves render with no chevron. Concurrency 6.
🔄 **Hidden columns** — hides Copy As Link, In Pool, Is Branch, Original ID, ID, Quantity, Master Part Source.
🔄 **Revision column merged** — PRT Revision and PI Part Revision merged into a single synthetic Revision column.
✨ **New icons** — BOM (purple hierarchy tree), Assembly (orange gear), Part (gray hex nut).
